name: Black & White Portraits
tagline: Timeless monochrome with deep shadows and real grain.
description: Fine-art monochrome portraits in every classic style: Rembrandt and butterfly light, high-key white, low-key chiaroscuro, window light, rainy street candids, film-noir hat shadows and wind-blown beach frames. Rich tonal range and honest grain, the kind of portrait that never dates.
